{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Confirm the filter worked
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_df)}")

# Inspect revenue values
print("\nRevenue values (first 10):")
print(completed_df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue is '999999.99' (QA orders)
qa_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
completed_df['revenue_float'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_df['revenue_float'].mean()

print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
